Just my today’s idea.

If you'll think it through and see what kind of factual basis decriers have for their accusations of CONSPIRACY THEORY! and then look at the factual basis for the ideas they claim are "conspiracy theories", you'll realize, no question, that the real conspiracy theorists are the ones shouting it.

 

They ain't got dickall to support their accusations -- nor do they feel like they need more than dickall.

 

The simple fact that information and theories formed to explain it lie far outside their dogmatic blinders is all it takes for them to brand both facts and theories as ridiculous and the people presenting them as idiots.

 

But who are the idiots, really: the people who looked at and thought about things that their decriers refuse to look at under the dumb pretense that all such is delusory, or the decriers who refuse to look and refuse to think by claiming don't-see-so-can't-be as their excuse?

 

With no evidence that the information and theories are incorrect, and with no interest to even understand how the information actually arose or how the theories were actually formed, they just dismiss the whole train without having ridden it an inch.

 

Does that sound intelligent to you?

 

Does that sound like the kind of people who want to know the truth?

 

Or does that sound more like people suffering from diagnosable paranoid delusions which the slightest bit of fact could topple so, to avoid the crash (which is inevitable anyway), they play ostrich?

comment.body:
The real question here isn’t whether he’s right or wrong.

The real question here is: Are you a cultist?

Do you prefer ignoramusing yourself to facing contradictory information?

Do you, therefore, refuse to look and honestly consider information that does not already obviously align with your “beliefs”?

Do you mock what you have not spent a single second or ounce of energy trying to understand?

Do you automatically suspect new sources just because your trusted authorities haven’t pre-approved them?

If so, you are a cultist—so what relevance does the truth or merit of what this guy says have to anything that matters? 

You yourself are your biggest problem.

Fix yourself before you pretend that you can fix anyone else.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
Protests, strikes, and rebellion do nothing to overcome oppressors, because they prove codependence—and oppressors are all too well aware.

Codependence has proven to be a very robust and simple way of understanding people. No codependence = no cultism, no matter the scenario or sector or sphere or field.

I fumbled for a long time looking for the healthy alternative. What are we doing when we're not being codependent? What is it about and what is it called?

Then I realized how crucial the role of codependent self-degradation is. It renders a people into a non-persons, tools, which is kinda the whole point for the psycho-ruler/killers among us. It's how they look at other human beings. They don't see precious persons, because they themselves aren't precious persons in their own eyes. It's just use or be used.

So, then, the alternative to codependence became obvious: embodying and operating in our natural, innate humanness. The opposite of codependence is humanness.

This has a bearing on anarchism. There's always been something that nagged me about anarchist thinking. It turns out that it shares a similar lack of humanness with archist (supremacists/authoritarian) thinking. Both very similarly try to approach human problems "objectively"—which in effect means inhumanly—in terms of mechanical structure, external forces, existential limitations, etc. You don't read much from either side of the “archy” question about the crucial centrality of our unmanipulated motivations—what we really want—as the cornerstone of successful relations in the human networks we call "societies". Both sides refer to "the masses" and treat people to some degree by dehumanizing them into tools, resources,  products, all faceless, not much more precious in the thinker’s ideas than a high-grade commodity.

To the degree that we eliminate subjectivity, we eliminate humanness.

Subjectivity is not a problem to be solved, nor is it the prime portal for bias and error like it's cracked up to be. The actual portal for bias and error is codependence, not subjectivity. Honest admission that we live, breathe, think, and act as thoroughly subjective beings who can find ways to mitigate our limitations counteracts the stupid thinking resulting precisely from erroneous denial of our limitations as subjective beings and helps us to avoid the slippery slope into superstition and eventual delusion which is so much greater a portal for idiocy and error that any comparison is ludicrous.

The psychopathic mentality doesn't denigrate and oppose subjectivity because of problems inherent to it, but because they are flat out incapable of navigating it, so they do what they always do: demonize, censor, erase, and destroy. Not only can't they manage the dance of healthy, constructive interpersonal relationships and dealings—the only way they find confidence to do anything at all is if they seize a position from which to dictate and force the dance to become a march they direct every step of the way.
